title: Promoted to Specialist 4
description: Larry was promoted to Specialist 4 (E-4) on May 15, 1965, during his year in Vietnam. It was the grade he held when he left the Army.
researchNotes: Added 2026-09-14 (the site audit listed the DD-214 promotions as missing from the timeline). Date of rank from DD-214 item 3b as read on the clear scan of 2026-08-15; the 2026-08-10 photo transcription had read May 13 (research/records-request/dd214-findings.md, "Clear-scan corrections"). "During his year in Vietnam" rests on the DD-214 foreign-service total and his own account of leaving in late August or early September 1965, not on a document placing him in Vietnam that day.
